CustomField.description: JSON map of picklist API value to custom display label ({"apiValue":"override label"}), edited via the Customize Option Labels modal in Form Builder. flowFormField swaps option labels at render (single and multiselect) and registers the map with flowFormHelper so {{merge}} substitution of the field's value resolves to the same display label; saved values always remain API names. Override labels support {{merge}} fields and custom labels; values without an entry keep their default translated label (#223).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maps picklist values to custom display labels, managed from the Customize Option Labels editor in Form Builder. Only what respondents see changes: saved values keep their API names, and any value without an override keeps its default label.
CustomField.label: Picklist Option Labels
